ruleset.name: under-test
ruleset.description: The failing rules: complexity limits, the parameter limit, and the test standard that a test makes exactly one assertion statement (several checks in one assertAll). Why each: docs/decisions. Advice that is reported but doesn't fail the build is in pmd-advice.xml.

rule.name: TestMustAssert
rule.message: A test makes exactly one assertion: this one makes none, so it can't fail when the code is wrong
rule.description: A test makes exactly one assertion statement. One with none passes whatever the code does. An assert*, assertThat(...), assertAll(...), assertThrows(...) or verify(...) call anywhere in the test counts, and so do the assertion styles of established test libraries: then() (REST Assured, BDDMockito), check(...) (ArchUnit), until*(...) (Awaitility) and shouldHold(...) (jetCheck), and fail(...), as in a test that fails in the catch of what it checks.

rule.name: MultipleAssertionsMustUseAssertAll
rule.message: A test makes one assertion, or one assertAll(...): split it, or group what it checks in one assertAll
rule.description: A test makes one assertion statement: one JUnit assert* call, one AssertJ assertThat(...) chain, one Mockito verify(...), or one assertAll(...) that groups several, so every failure in it is reported. A second statement means a second test, or the same one inside an assertAll.
